caption: The video captures a woman with long dark hair, in a blue knotted top, denim shorts and black thigh-high boots, positioned back to a fixed camera in a bright white studio. A mirror wall in front of her shows her front-facing reflection on the right. She dances in place, her position remaining roughly constant. One arm stays bent near her head and shoulder, sometimes extending outward to the side, while the other arm moves from an extended outward reach to a lower position by her side. In the mirror, the bent arm reads as a horizontal line across her chest, and the other arm appears extended downward. Her weight shifts between the two boots, with heels lifting and feet pivoting rather than traveling across the light wood floor. The knotted front of her top shifts slightly as her torso turns.
relations: One arm stays bent near her head, sometimes extending outward, while the other moves down to her side.
In the mirror, the bent arm appears as a horizontal line across her chest, and the other arm extends downward.
Her weight shifts between the boots, causing heels to lift and feet to pivot on the light wood floor.
When her torso turns, the knotted front of her blue top shifts slightly with the movement.
